title: Winy Shaggy Cakes with Eastern Croute
description: A unique fusion of flavors from the middle east, this dish combines the richness of seafood with the crunch of croute.

ingredients.name: Middle Eastern Spices
ingredients.notes: Mix of cumin, coriander, and paprika

ingredients.name: Seafood Mix
ingredients.notes: Combination of shrimp, scallops, and mussels

instructions: 1. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
2. Add the chopped shaggy and cook until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
3. Add the ground winy and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until it's no longer pink, about 5 minutes.
4. Stir in the Middle Eastern spices and cook for 1 minute.
5. Add the seafood mix and cook until it's pink and cooked through, about 3-4 minutes.
6. Stir in the crushed croute and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
7. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
8. Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
